The same cannot be said for the orgonomic model’s contention that the real cancer cells are amoeboid cells that arose de novo (heterogenically) from the vesicular byproducts of one or more dying or decaying tissue cells - or for the validity of the staging of cancer proposed by Reich. Correa Aurora Biophysics Research Institute, Concord, Ontario, Canada Abstract We provide experimental evidence that the Schumann frequency is not a characteristic of the ionospheric cavity per se, nor an electromagnetic function. Instead, using a three-band analyzer spanning 1 to 13 cps, we show that it can be picked up by an isolated ground connection inside a Faraday Cage room, and that, accordingly, it is a geo￾acoustic electric signature. We speculate on its novel causation, one that accounts for its presence in the crust, oceans and atmosphere. We suggest that the main Schumann frequency strikes a C0 tone at 8.0054 cps, rather than at 7.83 cps, and that the intercalation frequency of the damped wave responsible for the spectrum of the six Schumann resonances is A0 = 6.6711 cps.
